# FUTURE PACK TEMPLATE: unsealed; a fresh reviewed manifest hash is required.
# ExportAndVerify authenticates once and exports public bundle bytes; no decision, nonce, CI variables or execution.
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][ValidateSet('Preflight','Prepare','ExportAndVerify','VerifyExport')][string]$Stage,
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Manifest,
    [string]$Proof,
    [string]$CredentialFile,
    [string]$DecisionSha256
)
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$stageClock = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
$stageStartedAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow
$exportStartedAt = $null
$exportFinishedAt = $null
$exportElapsedSeconds = $null
$CaseId = '__CASE_ID__'
$ReviewedManifestSha256 = '<UNSET_REVIEWED_MANIFEST_SHA256>'

function Require([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message) {
    if (-not $Condition) { throw $Message }
}

function NoOneDrive([string]$Path) {
    Require ($Path -notmatch '(?i)(^|[\\/])OneDrive([\\/]|$)') 'OneDrive path refused.'
}
function InspectPathStrings($Value) {
    if ($null -eq $Value) { return }
    if ($Value -is [string]) { NoOneDrive $Value; return }
    if ($Value -is [System.Collections.IDictionary]) {
        foreach ($v in $Value.Values) { InspectPathStrings $v }; return
    }
    if ($Value -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable]) {
        foreach ($v in $Value) { InspectPathStrings $v }; return
    }
    if ($Value -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject]) {
        foreach ($p in $Value.PSObject.Properties) { InspectPathStrings $p.Value }
    }
}
function UnredirectedPath([string]$Path) {
    NoOneDrive $Path
    Require ([IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($Path)) 'Absolute path required.'
    $absolute = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
    NoOneDrive $absolute
    $part = $absolute
    while (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $part)) {
        $parent = [IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($part)
        Require (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($parent) -and $parent -ne $part) 'No existing path ancestor.'
        $part = $parent
    }
    $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $part -Force
    while ($null -ne $item) {
        Require (($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -eq 0) 'Redirected path refused.'
        NoOneDrive $item.FullName
        if ($item -is [IO.FileInfo]) { $item = $item.Directory } else { $item = $item.Parent }
    }
}
function IndependentRepository($Config) {
    $expected = '__REPOSITORY_ROOT__'
    UnredirectedPath $Config.repository
    Require ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Config.repository).TrimEnd([char]92) -ieq $expected.TrimEnd([char]92)) 'Wrong execution repository.'
    foreach ($name in @('GIT_DIR','GIT_COMMON_DIR','GIT_WORK_TREE','GIT_INDEX_FILE','GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY','GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES','GIT_CONFIG','GIT_CONFIG_COUNT','GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS')) {
        Require ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($name))) 'Git environment override refused.'
    }
    $metadata = Join-Path $expected '.git'
    UnredirectedPath $metadata
    Require ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $metadata -Force).PSIsContainer) 'Linked Git metadata refused.'
    foreach ($relative in @('commondir','objects/info/alternates','objects/info/http-alternates')) {
        Require (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $metadata $relative))) 'Shared Git metadata/objects refused.'
    }
    $gitProgram = (Get-Command git -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop).Source
    UnredirectedPath $gitProgram
    $actualGit = Native $gitProgram @('-C',$expected,'rev-parse','--absolute-git-dir')
    $actualCommon = Native $gitProgram @('-C',$expected,'rev-parse','--path-format=absolute','--git-common-dir')
    $actualTop = Native $gitProgram @('-C',$expected,'rev-parse','--show-toplevel')
    foreach ($actual in @($actualGit,$actualCommon)) {
        UnredirectedPath $actual
        Require ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($actual).TrimEnd([char]92) -ieq $metadata.TrimEnd([char]92)) 'Git metadata is not independent.'
    }
    UnredirectedPath $actualTop
    Require ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($actualTop).TrimEnd([char]92) -ieq $expected.TrimEnd([char]92)) 'Unexpected Git working tree.'
    Require ((Native $gitProgram @('-C',$expected,'rev-parse','HEAD')) -ceq $Config.executable_commit) 'Execution checkout is not the sealed executable.'
    Require ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty((Native $gitProgram @('-C',$expected,'status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all')))) 'Execution checkout is not clean/materialized.'
    Write-Host ('Independent execution repository verified: ' + $expected)
    Write-Host ('Git directory/common directory verified: ' + $metadata + '; OneDrive paths refused.')
}

function Regular([string]$Path) {
    UnredirectedPath $Path
    Require ([IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($Path)) 'Absolute path required.'
    $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $Path -Force
    Require (-not $item.PSIsContainer) 'Regular file required.'
    $part = $item
    while ($null -ne $part) {
        Require (($part.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -eq 0) 'Redirected path refused.'
        if ($part -is [IO.FileInfo]) { $part = $part.Directory } else { $part = $part.Parent }
    }
}
function Digest([string]$Path) {
    Regular $Path
    return (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
}
function Native([string]$Program, [string[]]$Arguments) {
    $value = (& $Program @Arguments | Out-String).Trim()
    $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    Require ($code -eq 0) ('Native command refused (exit ' + $code + '). Stop; no automatic retry.')
    return $value
}
function SigningWindow($Config) {
    $now = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow
    $start = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse($Config.signing_window.start)
    $end = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse($Config.signing_window.end)
    $executionEnd = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse($Config.execution_window.end)
    Require ($start -lt $end -and $end -le $executionEnd) 'Invalid reviewed windows.'
    Require ($now -ge $start -and $now -lt $end -and $now -lt $executionEnd) 'Outside reviewed signing/verification window. Stop.'
}

function PreparationWindow($Config) {
    $now = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow
    $signStart = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse($Config.signing_window.start)
    Require ($now -lt $signStart) 'Preparation must finish before signing begins. Defer a new pack; do not extend this pack.'
}
function StageWindow($Config) {
    if ($Stage -cin @('Preflight','Prepare')) { PreparationWindow $Config }
    else { SigningWindow $Config }
}

NoOneDrive $Manifest
if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Proof)) { NoOneDrive $Proof }
Require ($ReviewedManifestSha256 -cmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') 'DRAFT ONLY: exact reviewed manifest hash is not sealed. Do not fill values yourself.'
Require ((Digest $Manifest) -ceq $ReviewedManifestSha256) 'Manifest differs from exact reviewed bytes.'
$m = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Manifest -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
InspectPathStrings $m
UnredirectedPath $m.repository
UnredirectedPath $m.output_directory
Require ($m.case_id -ceq $CaseId -and $m.ready -eq $true) 'Wrong case or pack not ready.'
Require ($m.executable_commit -cmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') 'Exact executable missing.'
Require ($m.contract_sha256 -cmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') 'Exact contract missing.'
Require ($m.runtime_root -ceq '__RUNTIME_ROOT__') 'Unexpected installed runtime.'
Require ($m.factory_root -ceq '__FACTORY_ROOT__') 'Unexpected Factory root.'
Require ($m.factory_url -cin @('__FACTORY_URL__','__FACTORY_URL__')) 'Unexpected Factory address.'
StageWindow $m
foreach ($row in $m.files) {
    Require ($row.sha256 -cmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') 'Unsealed file hash.'
    Require ((Digest $row.path) -ceq $row.sha256) ('File hash mismatch: ' + $row.label)
}
foreach ($label in @('plan','contract','public-key','python','entry','journal-head','runtime-source-inventory')) {
    Require (@($m.files | Where-Object { $_.label -ceq $label }).Count -eq 1) ('Missing unique reviewed file: ' + $label)
}
function BoundPath([string]$Label) { return ($m.files | Where-Object { $_.label -ceq $Label }).path }
$python = BoundPath 'python'
$entry = BoundPath 'entry'
$journalReader = BoundPath 'journal-head'
$publicKey = BoundPath 'public-key'
$contract = BoundPath 'contract'
Require ($python -ceq (Join-Path $m.runtime_root 'python\python.exe')) 'Wrong Python runtime.'
Require ($entry -ceq (Join-Path $m.runtime_root 'app\tools\factory_install\entry.py')) 'Wrong installed entry.'
Require ($journalReader -ceq (Join-Path $m.runtime_root 'app\tools\factory_install\journal_head.py')) 'Wrong journal verifier.'
$runtimeInventory = Get-Content -LiteralPath (BoundPath 'runtime-source-inventory') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
Require ($runtimeInventory.complete -eq $true -and @($runtimeInventory.files).Count -gt 0) 'Runtime source inventory is incomplete.'
foreach ($row in $runtimeInventory.files) {
    Require ($row.sha256 -cmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') 'Unsealed runtime source hash.'
    Require ((Digest $row.path) -ceq $row.sha256) 'Installed source differs from reviewed inventory.'
}
Require ((Digest $contract) -ceq $m.contract_sha256) 'Contract bytes differ from reviewed canonical contract.'
$planValue = Get-Content -LiteralPath (BoundPath 'plan') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$contractValue = Get-Content -LiteralPath $contract -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
Require ($planValue.executable_commit -ceq $m.executable_commit -and $planValue.drill_admission.case_id -ceq $CaseId) 'Plan case/executable mismatch.'
Require ($contractValue.kind -ceq 'engineering-run-approval' -and $contractValue.details.executable_commit -ceq $m.executable_commit -and $contractValue.details.request_seal -ceq $planValue.content_sha256) 'Contract/plan binding mismatch.'
$contractStart = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse($contractValue.details.window.start)
$contractEnd = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse($contractValue.details.window.end)
$signStart = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse($m.signing_window.start)
$signEnd = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse($m.signing_window.end)
$executeStart = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse($m.execution_window.start)
$executeEnd = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse($m.execution_window.end)
Require ($contractStart -le $signStart -and $signStart -lt $signEnd -and $signEnd -le $executeStart -and $executeStart -lt $executeEnd -and $executeEnd -le $contractEnd) 'Reviewed signing and execution subwindows must be distinct and inside the exact hash-bound contract window.'
InspectPathStrings $planValue
InspectPathStrings $contractValue
IndependentRepository $m
$null = Native 'git' @('-C',$m.repository,'cat-file','-e',($m.executable_commit + '^{commit}'))
Require ([IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($m.output_directory)) 'Absolute output directory required.'
$output = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($m.output_directory)
foreach ($protectedRoot in @($m.factory_root,$m.runtime_root,$m.repository)) {
    $protectedAbsolute = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($protectedRoot).TrimEnd('\')
    Require ($output -ine $protectedAbsolute -and -not $output.StartsWith(($protectedAbsolute + '\'),[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) 'Output must be outside Factory data, runtime and repository.'
}
if ($Stage -ceq 'Preflight') {
    PreparationWindow $m
    [ordered]@{status='preflight-only';case_id=$CaseId;manifest_sha256=$ReviewedManifestSha256;started_at=$stageStartedAt.ToString('o');finished_at=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o');elapsed_seconds=$stageClock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds;signing_authorized=$false;execution_authorized=$false;note='Read-only local checks only. Separate full publication/main/fence/originals guards and terminal CI receipts are still required.'} | ConvertTo-Json
    return
}
$bound = Join-Path $output 'independent-bound.json'
$statePath = Join-Path $output 'prepared-state.json'
$readerPath = Join-Path $output 'read-independent-bound.py'
$boundReader = @'
import json, os, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
app = Path(r'__RUNTIME_ROOT__\app').resolve(strict=True)
root = Path(r'__FACTORY_ROOT__').resolve(strict=True)
mode, expected, output = sys.argv[1:]
assert mode in ('create', 'check') and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', expected)
target = Path(output)
assert target.is_absolute() and target.parent.is_dir() and not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root)
assert all(not p.is_symlink() and not getattr(p, 'is_junction', lambda: False)() for p in (target,*target.parents))
sys.path.insert(0, str(app / 'src')); sys.path.insert(1, str(app))
from lightyear_control_tower.factory_policy import FactoryInbox, factory_registry
item = FactoryInbox(root, 'factory', factory_registry()).item('factory-' + expected)
assert item['kind'] == 'engineering-run-approval' and item['scope'] == 'factory'
bound = item['bound']
assert set(bound) == {'contract','request'} and bound['contract'] == expected
assert all(isinstance(v,str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',v) for v in bound.values())
if mode == 'create':
    with target.open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(bound,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
        stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
else:
    assert json.loads(target.read_bytes()) == bound
print(json.dumps(dict(status='bound-verified',**bound)))
'@
if ($Stage -ceq 'Prepare') {
    Require (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $output)) 'Output already exists. Stop and inspect; do not re-import blindly.'
    $parent = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $output)
    while ($null -ne $parent) {
        Require (($parent.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -eq 0) 'Redirected output parent refused.'
        $parent = $parent.Parent
    }
    $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $output
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($readerPath,$boundReader,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    # The exact import route verifies contract source bindings; import is not a decision.
    # Hashing the full runtime inventory can take time. Recheck at the import boundary.
    StageWindow $m
    $importText = Native $python @('-I','-B',$entry,'import','--repository',$m.repository,'--root',$m.factory_root,'--contract',$contract)
    $imported = $importText | ConvertFrom-Json
    Require ($imported.schema -ceq 'tower-request/1' -and $imported.scope -ceq 'factory' -and $imported.kind -ceq 'engineering-run-approval') 'Imported request kind/scope mismatch.'
    Require ($imported.id -ceq ('factory-' + $m.contract_sha256) -and $imported.bound.contract -ceq $m.contract_sha256) 'Imported contract binding mismatch.'
    $independent = (Native $python @('-I','-B',$readerPath,'create',$m.contract_sha256,$bound)) | ConvertFrom-Json
    Require ($independent.status -ceq 'bound-verified') 'Independent bound failed.'
    $state = [ordered]@{preparation_started_at=$stageStartedAt.ToString('o');preparation_elapsed_seconds=$stageClock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds;case_id=$CaseId;manifest_sha256=$ReviewedManifestSha256;contract=$independent.contract;request=$independent.request;bound_sha256=(Digest $bound);reader_sha256=(Digest $readerPath);prepared_at=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o')}
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($statePath,($state | ConvertTo-Json),[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    # Do not invite a human decision if preparation used up the reviewed window.
    StageWindow $m
    Write-Output ($state | ConvertTo-Json)
    Write-Output 'STOP HERE. In existing Tower 8769, compare this request and record ONE campaign-authorizer approval. There is no Tower UI export button. Invoke this SAME sealed script with -Stage ExportAndVerify WITHIN the approved signing/verification window -Manifest <same reviewed manifest> -Proof <new absolute human-proof-bundle.json> -CredentialFile <existing operator credential file> -DecisionSha256 <exact decision SHA>. This authenticates once, exports the complete tower-decision-proof/1 bundle and immediately verifies it. Never export the bare event. Do not sign another decision or log in/out between export and verification. No execution is authorized.'
    return
}
Require (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Proof)) 'Exported raw proof path required.'
Regular $statePath
$state = Get-Content -LiteralPath $statePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
Require ($state.case_id -ceq $CaseId -and $state.manifest_sha256 -ceq $ReviewedManifestSha256) 'Wrong prepared state.'
Require ((Digest $bound) -ceq $state.bound_sha256 -and (Digest $readerPath) -ceq $state.reader_sha256) 'Prepared bound/reader changed.'
$expectedReaderBytes = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($boundReader)
$hasher = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
try { $readerHash = ([BitConverter]::ToString($hasher.ComputeHash($expectedReaderBytes))).Replace('-','').ToLowerInvariant() } finally { $hasher.Dispose() }
Require ((Digest $readerPath) -ceq $readerHash) 'Independent reader differs from this reviewed wrapper.'
$independent = (Native $python @('-I','-B',$readerPath,'check',$m.contract_sha256,$bound)) | ConvertFrom-Json
Require ($independent.status -ceq 'bound-verified' -and $independent.contract -ceq $state.contract -and $independent.request -ceq $state.request) 'Current imported bound changed.'

if ($Stage -ceq 'ExportAndVerify') {
    Require ($DecisionSha256 -cmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') 'Exact decision SHA required.'
    Require ($m.factory_url -ceq '__FACTORY_URL__') 'Only existing local Factory 8769 is allowed.'
    Regular $CredentialFile
    UnredirectedPath $Proof
    Require (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Proof)) 'Export already exists; stop, do not overwrite or retry.'
    Require ([IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Proof)) -ieq $output) 'Export must be in the reviewed external output directory.'
    Require ([IO.Path]::GetFileName($Proof) -ceq 'human-proof-bundle.json') 'Expected human-proof-bundle.json.'
    StageWindow $m
    $exportStartedAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow
    $exportClock = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    $handler = [System.Net.Http.HttpClientHandler]::new()
    $handler.AllowAutoRedirect = $false
    $handler.UseProxy = $false
    $http = [System.Net.Http.HttpClient]::new($handler)
    $http.Timeout = [TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(10)
    $http.MaxResponseContentBufferSize = 8388608
    $loginBody = $null; $loginResponse = $null; $bundleResponse = $null; $session = $null; $credential = $null
    try {
        $credential = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($CredentialFile).Trim()
        Require ($credential.Length -gt 0 -and $credential.Length -le 300) 'Credential format refused.'
        $loginBody = [System.Net.Http.StringContent]::new((@{credential=$credential} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress), [Text.Encoding]::UTF8, 'application/json')
        $http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add('Origin', $m.factory_url)
        StageWindow $m
        $loginResponse = $http.PostAsync(($m.factory_url + '/api/tower/session'), $loginBody).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
        Require ([int]$loginResponse.StatusCode -eq 200) 'Session refused; stop without retry.'
        $session = $loginResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult() | ConvertFrom-Json
        Require (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($session.token)) 'Missing session token.'
        $http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = [System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue]::new('Bearer', $session.token)
        StageWindow $m
        $bundleResponse = $http.GetAsync(($m.factory_url + '/api/tower/proof?sha256=' + $DecisionSha256)).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
        Require ([int]$bundleResponse.StatusCode -eq 200) 'Bundle export refused; stop without retry.'
        $bundleBytes = $bundleResponse.Content.ReadAsByteArrayAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult()
        Require ($bundleBytes.Length -gt 0 -and $bundleBytes.Length -le 8388608) 'Bundle size refused.'
        $candidate = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bundleBytes) | ConvertFrom-Json
        Require ($candidate.schema -ceq 'tower-decision-proof/1' -and $candidate.decision_sha256 -ceq $DecisionSha256) 'Expected complete proof bundle for the exact decision.'
        Require ($null -ne $candidate.journal.events -and $null -ne $candidate.journal.signature) 'Signed journal required.'
        $stream = [IO.File]::Open($Proof, [IO.FileMode]::CreateNew, [IO.FileAccess]::Write, [IO.FileShare]::None)
        try { $stream.Write($bundleBytes,0,$bundleBytes.Length); $stream.Flush($true) } finally { $stream.Dispose() }
        $exportClock.Stop()
        $exportElapsedSeconds = $exportClock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds
        $exportFinishedAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow
        # Preserve HTTP body bytes. Do not serialize JSON, logout or authenticate again.
    } catch {
        throw 'Export failed. Stop for inspection; no automatic retry, second decision or credential output.'
    } finally {
        if ($null -ne $loginBody) { $loginBody.Dispose() }
        if ($null -ne $loginResponse) { $loginResponse.Dispose() }
        if ($null -ne $bundleResponse) { $bundleResponse.Dispose() }
        $http.Dispose(); $handler.Dispose()
        $session = $null; $credential = $null
        # Clearing references is not a zeroization claim. No logout journal mutation.
    }
    StageWindow $m
}
$verificationStartedAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow
$verificationClock = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
$bundleShape = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Proof -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
Require ($bundleShape.schema -ceq 'tower-decision-proof/1') 'Bare events are not proof bundles.'

$proofHash = Digest $Proof
# Deliberately obtain trust AFTER export, from the independently verified local journal.
$head = Native $python @('-I','-B',$journalReader,'--root',$m.factory_root,'--public-key',$publicKey)
Require ($head -cmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') 'Independent journal head refused.'
StageWindow $m
$verification = (Native $python @('-I','-B',$entry,'tower','verify-decision','--record',$Proof,'--trusted-public-key',$publicKey,'--kind','engineering-run-approval','--scope','factory','--bound',$bound,'--journal-head',$head)) | ConvertFrom-Json
Require ($verification.status -ceq 'verified') 'Proof not verified.'
$proofValue = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Proof -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$events = @($proofValue.journal.events | Where-Object { $_.content_sha256 -ceq $proofValue.decision_sha256 })
Require ($events.Count -eq 1) 'Expected one matching verified decision.'
$event = $events[0]
Require ($event.payload.outcome -ceq 'approve' -and ($event.payload.validation.execution_authorized -is [bool]) -and $event.payload.validation.execution_authorized -eq $false) 'Expected decision-only approval; no execution authority.'
Require ('campaign-authorizer' -cin @($event.payload.roles_held) -and $event.actor.kind -ceq 'human') 'Expected human campaign-authorizer.'
$decisionTime = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse($event.occurred_at)
Require ($decisionTime -ge [DateTimeOffset]::Parse($m.signing_window.start) -and $decisionTime -lt [DateTimeOffset]::Parse($m.signing_window.end)) 'Decision outside reviewed signing window.'
Require ((Digest $Proof) -ceq $proofHash) 'Proof changed during verification.'
$headAfter = Native $python @('-I','-B',$journalReader,'--root',$m.factory_root,'--public-key',$publicKey)
Require ($headAfter -ceq $head) 'Journal changed after export/verification. Stop for review; do not create another decision.'
StageWindow $m
$verificationClock.Stop()
$verificationFinishedAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow
$summary = [ordered]@{export_elapsed_seconds=$exportElapsedSeconds;verification_started_at=$verificationStartedAt;verification_finished_at=$verificationFinishedAt;verification_elapsed_seconds=$verificationClock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds;verified_at=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o');stage_started_at=$stageStartedAt.ToString('o');stage_elapsed_seconds=$stageClock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds;decision_to_verified_seconds=([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow-$decisionTime).TotalSeconds;export_started_at=$exportStartedAt;export_finished_at=$exportFinishedAt;status='verified-decision-only';case_id=$CaseId;decision_sha256=$proofValue.decision_sha256;decision_time=$event.occurred_at;outcome=$event.payload.outcome;contract=$independent.contract;request=$independent.request;executable_commit=$m.executable_commit;proof_path=$Proof;proof_sha256=$proofHash;independent_journal_head=$head;execution_authorized=$false;nonce_consumed_by_wrapper=$false}
Write-Output 'PASTE THE FOLLOWING PUBLIC SUMMARY BACK TO THE OPERATOR CHAT:'
Write-Output ($summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5)
Write-Output 'STOP. Separate approval is required before CI variables, reservation or execution. No automatic retry.'
